display.purpose: Logo text only. Never used for body content.

body.purpose: Form inputs, entry values, general reading.

label.purpose: Form labels, stat labels, field headers.

mono.purpose: KPI values, profit/loss, calendar results — numbers that need alignment.

motion.name: ease-enter
motion.purpose: Ease-out-expo for section and toast entrances.

motion.name: duration-medium
motion.purpose: Toast enter, collapse expand, modal enter.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action — save a trade journal entry.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: block; width: auto; min-width: 200px; margin: 12px auto 0; padding: 12px 32px; background: #10B981; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 100px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.2px; transition: background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #059669; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10B981; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Default text and number input field.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); border: 1px solid #1E293B; border-radius: 8px; color: #F8FAFC; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; min-width: 0; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #10B981; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15), 0 0 20px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94A3B8; } .ds-input.error { border-color: #EF4444 !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12), 0 0 12px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10B981; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.html:
Section Title

Card content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 28px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 40%, rgba(16,185,129,0.03) 65%, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 100%); backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.3); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.3); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 12px; right: 12px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.18) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 80%, transparent 100%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.005); box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Segmented tab control for Journal / History view switching.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0; margin-bottom: 28px; border: 1px solid #1E293B; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; width: fit-content; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-tab { padding: 10px 28px; background: transparent; border: none; color: #94A3B8; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; letter-spacing: 0.2px; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #F8FAFC; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); } .ds-tab.active { color: #fff; background: #10B981; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10B981; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stat Item
components.description: Dashboard statistic tile — label + large value.
components.css: .ds-stat { padding: 16px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); border: 1px solid #1E293B; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-stat:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #94A3B8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.3px; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.5px; line-height: 1; color: #F8FAFC; } .ds-stat-value.profit { color: #22C55E; } .ds-stat-value.loss { color: #EF4444; }

components.name: Toggle (Buy/Sell)
components.description: Direction toggle for trade entry form — Buy (green) / Sell (red).
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: flex; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border: 1px solid #1E293B; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; height: 40px; } .ds-toggle-btn { flex: 1; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; border: none; color: #94A3B8; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; letter-spacing: 0.2px; } .ds-toggle-btn:hover { color: #F8FAFC; } .ds-toggle-btn.active { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-toggle-btn[data-value="BUY"].active { background: #10B981; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(16,185,129,0.3); } .ds-toggle-btn[data-value="SELL"].active { background: #EF4444; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(239,68,68,0.3); } .ds-toggle-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10B981; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip/Badge
components.description: Direction or result badge — Buy (emerald) / Sell (red).
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; } .ds-chip.buy { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15); color: #10B981; } .ds-chip.sell { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.15); color: #EF4444; }

narrative.overview: A calm, precise space for recording and reviewing trades — like a scientist's lab notebook where every entry is deliberate and nothing is decorative. The interface recedes so the data leads. The system uses a deep dark background with subtle green radial glows that suggest the brand without announcing it. Cards use soft glassmorphism — transparent enough to see the background glow through, solid enough to read comfortably. Motion is restrained: only state changes and section entrances, no choreography.
keyCharacteristics: Deep, quiet dark background with ambient green undertones
Glassmorphism used with restraint — functional depth, not decoration
Green accent is purposeful and sparing (≤10% of any screen)
Calm, unhurried motion — ease-out-expo curves, no bounce or elastic
Information density that rewards attention without overwhelming

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Emerald is the only accent. It appears on ≤10% of any screen. When everything is highlighted, nothing is.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No font pairings. Inter at every weight is the entire system.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No surface casts a shadow at rest. Shadows communicate interactivity; a static card has nothing to say.

dos: Do use emerald sparingly — as a signal, not a theme.
Do let the dark background breathe. Cards are transparent; the glow should show through.
Do use Inter at every weight. No second font family.
Do use ease-out-expo curves for motion (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).
Do use tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for all numerical data.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: replace enter animations with instant appearance.
Do use the tonal layering (bg → card-bg) for depth at rest; shadows only for interaction.
donts: Don't use gradient text or any background-clip: text effect.
Don't add glassmorphism decoratively — every frosted surface has a functional reason.
Don't use a second accent color. Emerald is the single signal.
Don't add side-stripe borders (left/right colored bars on cards or alerts).
Don't use bounce or elastic easing. Never.
Don't use numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) as decorative scaffolding.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top, left) if transform/opacity can do the job.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number + small label + gradient accent).
Don't make the UI feel childish or gamified — no badges, rewards, bright neons, or playful illustrations.
Don't sacrifice contrast for elegance — body text must hit 4.5:1 against its background.
